nodes.label: FBT Variant-Aware Add-to-Cart Rule
nodes.summary: Every storefront surface that calls cart.addItem() must detect variant-parent products and gate the add with a bilingual toast + redirect to PDP. Silent failure is worse than a clear prompt.

nodes.label: Every Add-to-Cart Surface Must Be Audited
nodes.summary: When shipping variant detection on one surface (FBT), all other cart-add surfaces must be audited for the same gap: CartRecommendations, Wishlist move-to-cart, Quick-add modal.

nodes.label: hasVariants(p) Detection Helper
nodes.summary: Derive `hasVariants(p)` from `Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants.length > 0` — every component needing variant detection should use this shared helper. If the API omits variants the field is undefined, not an error.

nodes.label: FBT Partition Pattern: simple vs needVariant
nodes.summary: Add-all-to-cart splits its product list into simple (add immediately) and needVariant (show info toast listing variant products by name). Never silently skip variant products — the count mismatch must surface.

nodes.label: Serial Awaits for Batch Cart Adds (No Promise.all)
nodes.summary: Batch cart additions must use sequential awaits, not Promise.all — parallel adds race against each other because the second add reads a pre-first-add cart state, causing lost items.

nodes.label: Prisma Include Rule for Variant-Gated Features
nodes.summary: Every API endpoint driving add-to-cart UX must include `variants: { select: { id: true, price: true } }` in its Prisma select. TypeScript won't catch a missing relation — it silently reads undefined and the branch fails to no-op.

nodes.label: Bilingual Variant-Gate Toast
nodes.summary: Variant detection toasts must be bilingual (EN + AR). Arabic merchants see broken UX if the toast is English-only. Toast includes the product name in the active locale and redirects to the PDP.

nodes.label: Admin Live Preview Pattern
nodes.summary: Every per-store admin styling form renders a live preview block alongside edit fields that mirrors the storefront emitter in real time, before Save. Eliminates the save→reload→check loop for visual customisation.

nodes.label: cfgToInlineStyle — Mirror-the-Emitter Helper
nodes.summary: `cfgToInlineStyle(cfg, theme)` takes the same shape the storefront's CSS emitter consumes and returns a React inline-style object. Same logic, different output target — reused by both zone previews and preset mini-previews.

nodes.label: Concrete previewText Rule
nodes.summary: Preview blocks must use real storefront sample strings (e.g. 'Latest Products' / 'Premium Saffron Tea'), not generic placeholders like 'Sample text'. Merchants must gauge how their actual content will render.

nodes.label: dir-Aware Preview Block
nodes.summary: Admin preview blocks must wrap content in `dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}` so RTL layout (text-align, padding direction) renders correctly for Arabic merchants. Missing dir makes AR preview misleading.

nodes.label: Brand-Preset Hex Resolution in Previews
nodes.summary: Admin previews must resolve brand-preset tokens to literal hex via `hslComponentsToHex(theme.primaryColor)`. CSS vars like `var(--primary)` inside React inline styles don't compute and silently fall back to inherit.

nodes.label: Admin Styling UX Verification Checklist
nodes.summary: Any new admin styling surface must pass 5 checks: (1) no-save preview, (2) concrete sample text, (3) brand colours resolved, (4) correct AR layout, (5) one-click preset for fast onboarding.

nodes.label: Best-of-Both-Worlds Principle
nodes.summary: Admin styling UIs should pair fine-grained per-zone controls for power users with multi-zone quick-style presets for onboarding merchants. Both audiences hit the same page — don't pick one or the other.

nodes.label: Multi-Zone Quick-Style Presets
nodes.summary: Every admin styling surface exposes 3-5 preset buttons that apply a coherent look across related zones in one click. Presets merge into existing zone settings (don't replace), preserving unrelated fields.

nodes.label: Preset Merge Semantics
nodes.summary: Applying a preset merges into existing zone settings — doesn't replace. Empty-string values in a preset explicitly clear that field. After merge, strip empty strings before API submission (Zod rejects empty optional fields).

nodes.label: Mini-Preview Inside Preset Button
nodes.summary: Each preset button renders a tiny live preview using `cfgToInlineStyle(preset.zoneSettings[mainZone], theme)` so merchants compare styles at a glance before clicking. Reuses the same helper as the zone-level preview — zero extra cost.

nodes.label: Clear N Styles Companion Button
nodes.summary: Presets must ship with a 'Clear N styles' button that deletes only the preset's target zones from state — preserving all unrelated zone settings. Nuking the full zone map is the wrong reset.

nodes.label: Preset Zone Scope Rule
nodes.summary: Pick 3-5 visually-related high-impact zones for a preset group — not the whole store. Section headings (kicker + title + subtitle + seeAll) are the reference scope. One mega-preset that styles everything is too coarse.

nodes.label: Preset Labels Must Be Bilingual
nodes.summary: Every preset label, description, and button must carry both `label`/`labelAr` and `description`/`descriptionAr`. Arabic-mode merchants must not see English preset names.

nodes.label: Preset Pattern Expansion Targets
nodes.summary: Multi-zone quick presets apply beyond typography: Categories card design (size+aspect+shape+gap), Hero banner (image+overlay+headline+CTA), Footer columns+copyright — anywhere 3+ related-but-individually-controllable fields exist.
